sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface localisation confirmed by WGA co-staining (L6); subcellular localisation studies performed (L4/L6). Functional assays beyond surface display not reported in these clips.
sites.rationale: L4 explicitly states the Flag-tag was placed 'immediately after the signal sequence of APLP1', which by the authoritative landmarks ends at residue 38 (G); the tag therefore sits between residue 38 and residue 39 (S), the mature N-terminus of the extracellular domain (39–583). Python lookup confirms seq[38]='G' and seq[39]='S'. L6 independently confirms surface display of FLAG-Aplp1 by WGA co-staining, elevating confidence. The junction is 545 residues from the TM boundary (584), satisfying all distance constraints. Full-length membrane-anchored APLP1 expressed from pCMV-Sport6 with a Flag-tag inserted immediately after the signal sequence (residues 1–38) using QuikChange mutagenesis (L4). Surface display of FLAG-Aplp1 constructs was independently confirmed by co-staining with the membrane marker WGA-Alexa Fluor 488 (L6). L2 corroborates the same junction with a 3×Myc tag preceded by the APP signal peptide.

sources.claim: A Flag-tag was incorporated immediately after the signal sequence of APLP1 and APLP2 in pCMV-Sport6 using the QuikChange lightning mutagenesis kit (Agilent).

literature_notes: Six ledger lines were examined. L4 and L6 together ground one high-confidence extracellular N-terminal site (Flag after SP, residue 38→39). L2 corroborates the same junction with a 3×Myc tag. All C-terminal tags (L1 Citrine/Cerulean, L2 3×HA, L3 FKBP+HA, L5 GFP) are fused to the intracellular C-terminus (residues 604–650) and are therefore not surface tag sites; they are recorded in other_positions. No internal extracellular loop insertion was reported in any ledger line for APLP1.

literature_other_positions.note: APLP1-Citrine and APLP1-Cerulean C-terminal fusions expressed for subcellular localisation; C-terminus falls in the intracellular domain (604–650).
FKBP+HA tag fused to the C-terminus of APLP1 (APLP1 F1) for inducible dimerisation; C-terminus is intracellular.
APLP1-GFP C-terminal fusion generated by ligation into GFP-N1; C-terminus is intracellular.
